sentences.text: Current sailing means finding a course to steer that cancels a known current.
Draw your intended track from your position to your destination.
From your starting point, draw the current vector, its set and its drift for one hour.
Then, from the end of the current vector, swing an arc equal to your boat speed until it crosses the intended track.
The line from the end of the current vector to that crossing point is your course to steer.
The distance from your start to the crossing point along the track is your speed made good.
You’ll practice this in the plotting module.
